d:
Kya sabse bara bhakt bhi satta ke ahankar se achhuta rah sakta hai?
'amrit gathaen' ke antargat 'lilamay dev sangram' men banasur ki divy gatha, bhagvan shiv ke prati uski bhakti, bhagvan shiv aur bhagvan krishn ke bich ka adbhut yuddh, aur ahankar ki antim parajay ke bare men janen.
Lilamay dev sangram | Leelamay Dev Sangram | Amrit Gaathayein | T-Series Bhakti Sagar
Can even the greatest devotee remain untouched by the pride of power?
